items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: Charlie Parker could be blamed for a lot of, you know, everyone trying to sound like Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: Do you think European musicians play significantly different?

Some of them do, for sure. I think you take someone like Jan Garbarek and he can play the saxophone in a lot of different ways. But you’re going to hear a very strong Norwegian, folk kind of element in his playing because that’s what he wants to pursue. But there are also a lot of European musicians who pride themselves on playing bebop and that want to be like American jazz musicians, and there you won’t hear much difference really. I mean you’ll hear guys pretty much sound, it’s interesting, they sound the same…
